title: Data and code for the Qilian Mountain ESI early-warning study
description:
Analysis pipeline and processed datasets for a reproducible ecological-security early-warning assessment of the Qilian Mountain region, China (2005-2023).

Contents
- Analysis pipeline (Python): DPSIR indicator construction, combined AHP-entropy weighting, ESI time series, grey forecasting (GM(1,1), NGBM, ARIMA) with rolling-origin backtest, GeoDetector spatial attribution, and obstacle-degree diagnosis.
- Processed datasets (CSV): regional and county indicators, weights, forecast results, GeoDetector statistics, and point-sampled spatial ESI.
- Figure and table source data for the manuscript. run_county_esi.py reproduces the county-level ESI reported in Table 6 (see README_county_esi.md for the frozen specification).

Environment: Python 3.11 (xarray, rasterio, pyproj, pandas, numpy, statsmodels, scikit-learn).
Inputs: CRU TS 4.10 (climate) and CLCD v1.0 (land cover), both openly available.
